completeConfirmDesc: After completion, changes can only be made as amendments.
lockedBanner: The visit is locked — direct editing is unavailable.
lockedBannerAmend: Changes are saved as an amendment with a stated reason.
referralWorkflow: Send lab, ultrasound, or another doctor to cashier. After payment the referred doctor writes a report — it becomes visible to the main doctor.
noUziDoctors: No ultrasound specialist in this branch
specialistReferralRequired: Select a doctor and their consultation service
specialistServiceMissing: No consultation service found for this doctor
uziReferralRequired: Select an ultrasound service and doctor
printPdfHint: Prints the same A4 PDF as lab results: clinic letterhead at the top, Made with AviShifo.uz at the bottom. Choose an A4 printer and A4 paper.
printPreviewFailed: Could not preview the PDF here. Click “Open PDF”.
printFailed: Could not start printing. Click “Open PDF” and print from there.

rx.editorHint: Write each medicine separately, check the prescription preview and save the complete prescription.
rx.readOnlyHint: Saved prescription and physiotherapy recommendations for this consultation.
rx.saveHint: All medicines and physiotherapy are saved together. Save your changes before confirming the consultation.
rx.combineTitle: Add this medicine to the previous mixture?
rx.combineHint: This ingredient will use the previous group’s administration directions. Its own form, quantity, dose, route, frequency, duration and instructions will be cleared.
rx.ingredientHint: Only the medicine name and strength are entered here. Administration directions come from the first medicine in the group.
rx.removeHint: Remove this medicine from the draft? Save the prescription to apply the change.
rx.removeGroupHint: All {count} medicines in this group will be removed from the draft together. The ingredients will not be attached to another medicine.
rx.emptyHint: Add medicines or enter physiotherapy below.
rx.invalid: Check each medicine name and the field lengths.
rx.physiotherapyHint: Choose a suggestion or write your own directions. General recommendations remain in the consultation’s Recommendations field.
rx.conflictHint: Your draft is still here. Reload the latest saved prescription to continue; your unsaved draft will be discarded only after confirmation.
rx.discardHint: The latest saved prescription will be loaded. Unsaved medicines and physiotherapy changes will be discarded.
rx.lockedDraft: This consultation is now locked. The saved prescription is shown; your pending changes were not saved.

instructions: in the morning on an empty stomach

rx.combineGroupHint: All {count} medicines in this group will be added to the previous mixture. Their administration directions will come from that mixture; this group’s own directions will be cleared.

labReferral.workflow: Select tests and send to the cashier. The laboratory starts after payment; approved results appear in this patient’s history.
